requirement_vague: Getting user by ID should reject invalid UUID format. Test with 'not-a-uuid' string. Admin credentials: admin@example.com / password123
requirement_precise: Login as superuser (admin@example.com / password123) to get token. Attempt to GET /api/v1/users/not-a-uuid (invalid UUID format). Verify the response status is 422 (validation error).

implementation.reasoning: The path parameter is typed as UUID, so FastAPI/Pydantic validates the path value before entering the handler. Supplying 'not-a-uuid' to GET /api/v1/users/not-a-uuid results in FastAPI's validation error response with status 422, and the endpoint is protected by authenticated user access, which an admin token satisfies.
